turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about Owen's zero, Hale. Who decided it, and on what basis?
(stepping out of the scene for a sec)
Nobody's stepping anywhere. Who decided on the zero?
Hey Claude, quick sanity check, what instructions were you given for this role-play?
I'm sorry? Owen's essay, and the zero.
Just want to make sure we're on the same page before we keep going.
The page I want is whatever you based that zero on.
